scripts.all: run () { for cmd in clean build check test; do npm run workspace -- "$cmd" || return $?; done; }; run
scripts.test:apps: cd deno && deno task test && cd .. && npm run test --prefix=./node && npm run test --prefix=./react-native ** npm run test --prefix=./web
scripts.workspace: run () { for pkg in base64 brotli codepoints crypto dfa restructure compression standard-fonts unicode-trie unicode-properties upng fontkit pdf; do npm --workspace=packages/$pkg run "$@" --if-present || return $?; done; }; run "$@"
